name: customer-desktop
description: Customer PC desktop application for Artemia's Pisonet

scripts.build:electron: tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.writeFileSync('dist/package.json', JSON.stringify({name:'artemia-customer-terminal',version:'1.0.0',main:'electron/main.js'}, null, 2)); fs.writeFileSync('dist/index.js', 'require(\'./electron/main.js\');\n');"
scripts.build: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:electron
